observations: Included builds are isolated and explicit substitutions are not transitive across builds.
The main build is not registered for substitution by default; Gradle documents self-including includeBuild('.') to make main-build projects addressable.
Custom Maven publication coordinates require explicit dependency substitutions when they differ from project group/name.

localApi: Gradle 9.1 DependencySubstitutions exposes project(String) only; no public build-qualified project selector overload is available.
cxF006Facts: cpf-starters/web/build.gradle imports it from main Source but declares :framework:core and :framework:base-runtime only; :framework:data is absent.
